name: Orbital Settings
description: Design Graph of the Orbital Settings screen (SettingsPage) including the PageHeader instance it renders.

sourceSummary.label: Orbital style dictionaries (brushes, surfaces, text styles, buttons, animations)

properties.layout: header row + scrollable content; content is a 24-gap stack with a full-width profile card above a two-column grid (about left; paths and actions right)

searchTrigger.appearance: bordered pill with search icon (glyph E721), mono placeholder 'Search or run command...', and a 'Ctrl+K' keyboard-shortcut chip

evidence.rationale: ScrollViewer hosting the page's card stack in row 1 of the root grid.

properties.style: OrbitalCardStyle (Surface1 background, Surface3 1px border, 12px radius, 20px padding)
properties.sectionTitleStyle: OrbitalSectionHeader (11px Medium mono, uppercase text, wide tracking, Text38 foreground)
properties.entrance: starts at Opacity 0 with TranslateY 8; faded/slid in on page load

evidence.rationale: Four section containers (ProfileSection, AboutSection, PathsSection, ActionsSection) share the same OrbitalCardStyle chrome, an uppercase OrbitalSectionHeader title, comparable inner spacing, and identical entrance treatment.

properties.initialValue: loaded from SettingsService.GetStoredUsername() on page load

properties.onClick: persists trimmed textbox value via SettingsService.SaveUsername, then shows 'Saved!' label for 1500 ms

nodes.text: This name appears in the homepage greeting.

properties.layout: label left, value right-aligned, single line
properties.textStyle: OrbitalMonoSmall for both parts; Text50 label, Text72 value

evidence.rationale: Four identically structured label/right-aligned-value rows in the About card share styles, colors, and purpose.

properties.layout: stacked label over wrapping value, 8px gap
properties.textStyle: OrbitalMonoSmall for both parts; Text50 label, Text72 value; value wraps

evidence.rationale: Three identically structured stacked label/wrapping-value groups in the Paths card share styles, colors, and purpose.

properties.style: OrbitalGhostButtonSm (transparent background, Text55 foreground, 8px radius, 12,6 padding)
properties.layout: left-aligned icon (14px FontIcon) + label, stretched full width, 8px gap

evidence.rationale: Three identically structured ghost buttons in the Actions card share style, icon+label composition, and alignment.

properties.label: Clear Recent Projects

properties.label: Uno Platform Documentation

unresolved.question: What UI does the PageHeader search-trigger open? Tapping raises the static SearchRequested event, but no subscriber is visible in the allowed sources.
unresolved.reason: Event subscriber lives outside the analyzed files; asserting a navigates-to or triggers target would be invention.

unresolved.question: What DataContext/ViewModel supplies the bound values (VersionDisplay, EnvStatus.UnoSdkVersion, DotNetDisplay, EnvStatus.Renderer, PlatformInfo, ProjectRoot, RecentsPath, SkillsPath)?
unresolved.reason: Binding paths are declared in XAML, but the DataContext type is set outside the analyzed files.

unresolved.question: How does the two-column grid behave at narrow width? Padding is responsive (16 narrow / 32 normal-wide) but the two columns are fixed in the analyzed markup.
possibleValues: columns remain side by side at all widths
an adaptive rule elsewhere stacks the columns
unresolved.reason: Only the AutoLayout padding uses a Responsive extension; no column adaptation is declared in the analyzed files.

unresolved.question: Are the four section containers a single reusable card component, or four one-off containers that coincidentally share OrbitalCardStyle?
unresolved.reason: No declared shared component exists; consolidation is inferred (0.85) from shared style, section-header pattern, and entrance treatment.
